# Kosha

> Kosha is a free, open-source (MIT) personal finance tracker for every account you have, in any currency. Add each payment in a few seconds on your phone, then see where the month went and check it against your bank on a desktop. It runs at https://getkosha.app, and anyone can host their own copy on Cloudflare Workers.

Kosha keeps bank accounts, cash, credit cards and investments in one place. Totals convert at daily exchange rates, and net worth counts what a credit card owes and what an investment has gained. Each person sees only their own data. Sign-in uses a password, a passkey or Google, with optional two-factor codes.

Main features:

- One-line entry such as `12.50 groceries yesterday`, which fills in the amount, category, date and account.
- The current month: spending so far against your usual pace, a projection to the month's end, and bills still to pay.
- Subscriptions and bills as schedules, recorded when they fall due.
- Transfers and currency exchange between your own accounts, which never count as spending.
- Tags and events (such as a trip) to see what something cost in total.
- Bank statement import (CSV, OFX, QFX, and PDF with AI) and reconciliation, with checks that explain a difference.
- Receipts and payslips attached to transactions.
- Optional AI with the user's own provider key: auto-categorise, natural-language add, receipt scanning, a monthly recap and Ask Kosha. Users choose which fields AI may see.
- A REST API and an MCP server, so assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor can read and add transactions.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/amruthpillai/kosha/blob/main/README.md): features, running it locally and deploying your own copy
- [API reference](https://getkosha.app/api/v1/docs): the REST API under /api/v1, authenticated with API keys from Settings › API & MCP
- [OpenAPI document](https://getkosha.app/api/v1/openapi.json): the same API as OpenAPI JSON
- MCP server: https://getkosha.app/mcp (OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; every REST operation is also an MCP tool)
